SELECT strftime('%Y', o.created_at) AS sales_year, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount - oi.quantity * p.cost) AS gross_profit FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') GROUP BY sales_year
LIMIT 100
